_meta.description: ARK carries an app from a green test run to the App Store, Google Play and the Microsoft Store: QA, security audits, screenshots, eight languages and release, then measures what happens next.
_title: ARK · The app-pipeline suite · Blaine Miller
a-security-review-on.7dea6a: A security review on every release
apple-s-platforms-through.cb19ee: Apple's platforms through the App Store, Android through Google Play, and Windows through the Microsoft Store. Soren also tests Rust, Gradle and Node projects, and Levi covers String Catalogs, store listings, Android resources and web dictionaries.
ark-is-my-app.39af56: ARK is my app-pipeline suite: seven small tools that test, audit, frame, translate and release every app I make, then watch how it lands.
ark-is-private-for.a76f48: ARK is private for now, and open-sourcing is planned. Monkr and Tom are open source today.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
does-hopps-put-tracking.4a648e: Does Hopps put tracking in my apps?
every-gate-is-an.13c8c7: 🚦 Every gate is an exit code
framed-and-fluent-in.b03479: Framed, and fluent in eight languages
hopps-gathers-what-the.a8dd0e: Hopps gathers what the stores, the website and social channels report into one private dashboard. Every ticket and suggestion has a Fix with Claude button.
knox-reads-the-real.045437: Knox reads the real source, domain by domain, from the threat model to the supply chain, and ranks what it finds. A new high-severity finding stops the line.
made-for-agents-gated.618fb5: Made for agents. Gated for people.
monkr-turns-fresh-captures.4947d6: Monkr turns fresh captures into framed store screenshots. Levi fills every gap in the Big 8 languages, then proves nothing is missing.
no-every-tool-is.1f1c36: No. Every tool is a plain command-line program you can run by hand. The AI steps, Knox's audits, Levi's translations and Hopps's fixes, work best with Claude Code, and they always write files for a person to review.
no-hopps-only-reads.6b9cd1: No. Hopps only reads what the stores, Cloudflare and the social platforms already report. There are no tracking SDKs in the apps, and the dashboard runs on your own Mac, reachable only over your private Tailscale network.
not-yet-ark-is.1db989: Not yet. ARK is private while it's prepared for release, and open-sourcing is planned. Two of its tools are already free and open source: Monkr for screenshots and Tom for music.
one-vessel-all-the.764b96: One vessel, all the animals, built to ship.
rocket-drafts-the-release.69740e: Rocket drafts the release, pushes the listing, uploads the build and submits it to the App Store, Google Play and the Microsoft Store.
soren-runs-every-test.d92cdc: Soren runs every test suite on every platform, from Xcode to Rust, Gradle and Node. A release waits until the whole board is green.
the-german-tagline-is.ad9846: The German tagline is cut off on the iPad screenshots.
then-it-watches-and.ce9e15: Then it watches, and loops back
what-hopps-learns-becomes.d8a045: ↺What Hopps learns becomes the next change.
